narrative:
Pricing and gross-to-net turn volume into net sales. Indexed to the US, net prices sit at 49-66 in Europe, around 71 in Japan and 28-34 in China. Average gross-to-net deductions are 19.3%, up 1.2pp on FY2025.

In the US, GTN pressure comes from Medicaid mix (Strensiq paediatric enrolment), 340B contract pharmacy volume and rebate demand on the residual Soliris book as biosimilars arrive. In Europe, JCA and national HTA re-assessments imply 4-6% net price pressure on complement inhibitors.

Each move is quantified here before it reaches the P&L, on the same governed GTN model that revenue management uses.
